## Must-Fix 1 (conclusion-changing) — ACCEPTED, fixed in v2

v1's leg-C recipe `hub.retry_transient(lambda: api.list_repo_tree(...))`
**retries nothing.** `HfApi.list_repo_tree` in huggingface_hub 0.36.2 ends
`for path_info in paginate(...): yield ...` — calling it performs ZERO HTTP and
returns a generator; every cursor page fires at ITERATION time. `retry_transient`
(= `_retry_upload`, `hub.py:1596`, `return fn()`) retries only the thunk, so the
lambda returns the lazy generator instantly and the #920 failure class (a
transient 504 on a cursor page) still kills the caller — now OUTSIDE the retry
envelope, under a `# HUB_VERIFY_RETRY_EXEMPT:` comment asserting it is retried.

That is a false justification, and it is exactly the "silence the check without
stating why each site is safe" shape the task body forbids. The lint would have
gone green (it only checks waiver presence), so this would have shipped: the
round's stated purpose for leg C — adding the retry property — would silently
never have landed. The canonical helper documents the same trap in its own
docstring (`hub.py::list_repo_entries_complete` L945-947, #794/#658).

Fix in v2+: materialize the CONSUMPTION inside the thunk, per-site, with the
value change (generator → list) stated honestly rather than claiming "changes no
returned value". Critic verified all five consumption shapes: comprehension
(`marker_panel:210`, `refusal_panel:116`), bare `for` (`sae_map:378`), outer
`list(...)` (`separate_pca_fit:55`, `separate_umap_fit:87`).
